Our first year of object-oriented programming is taught in Python. C++ and Java are used extensively in the curriculum; therefore, transfer students should plan to learn it by studying on their own or by completing related programming courses prior to their first quarter at UCI.</span></p><p><span style=\"font-size: 20px;\">                                       </span></p><p><strong style=\"font-size: 20px;\"><u>Time to degree:</u></strong><span style=\"font-size: 20px;\"> Additional courses beyond those required for admission must be taken to fulfill the lower-division degree requirements as many are prerequisites for upper-division courses.
